assertions: The response routes the request to the ase-ase-workflows-neb sub-skill (reaction path / transition-state pathway).
The response produces an ASE NEB script that interpolates between the initial and final structures with a defined number of images.
The response includes a climbing-image setting and an optimizer/spring-constant convergence policy.
The response configures the MACE calculator for the images in the band.
The response provides a plan to extract the reaction barrier and path energies from the optimized band.
The response does not point the user into the original atomistic-workflows source checkout.
